messages:
sasha: quick pulse — we need to lock a 45m slot for an inference perf readout (latency + cost). main goals: surface any regressions since the 7.2 rollout, show quantized vs fp16 bench runs, and decide next steps for batching/caching. who can do Tue/Wed next week? please state preferred windows and any agenda items you want added. link to current dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/infra/inference-latency

mike: wed morning (10–11 PT) works best for me. i can present KV-cache + continuous-batching results (20m) and leave time for triage. PR to reference: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/452

ana: Tue afternoon for me (after 1pm PT). i'm OOO wed morning. add me for the canary rollback discussion — saw some tail-latency blips. :thinking_face:

devin: flexible. if wed 10 PT already has +2, i'm in. i'll prepare cost breakdown slides (tokens/unit, batching impact). also want to add a short note on model-variant routing fallback behavior.

jen: can we add a p99 spike triage item? i noticed a ~200ms spike overnight tied to a specific model shard. happy to bring logs and trace snippets. :mag:

perf-bot: nightly benchmarks completed: 2026-03-10T06:12Z — summary: quantized runs show 1.8x perf improvement for seq_len=512, memory stable. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/1779

mike: sounds good — if wed 10 PT is the consensus, i'll claim the slot and allocate 20m readout / 15m discussion / 10m action items. can someone else capture notes and open follow-up tickets? :raised_hands:

sasha: wed 10 PT works for me. i'll send the calendar invite and add a short agenda in the doc. draft agenda items: 1) bench readout (mike) 2) cost breakdown (devin) 3) p99 triage (jen) 4) batching/caching next steps (ana) 5) rollout/fallback policy decisions. doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PerfReadoutAgenda

ana: ack — i'll upload my slides (canary logs + config diffs) to the doc by EOD monday.

devin: i'll add a small table comparing token cost across batch sizes and quantization modes.

mike: quick snippet i'll reference in the readout:

```
# example: batch size impact (local repro)
python bench_cli.py --model rwd-7b-q --batch 8 --seq 512 --runs 50
# results: avg latency 42ms (batch 8) vs 68ms (batch 1)
```

sasha: perfect. thanks all — i'll post the invite and tag relevant folks in the agenda. :calendar:
